mapper.select: SELECT jp.JOB_POSTS_IDX AS jobPostsIdx, cu.COMPANY_NAME AS companyName, jp.TITLE AS title, jp.EMPLOYMENT_TYPE AS employmentType, jp.CAREER AS career, jp.EDUCATION AS education, jp.SALARY AS salary, jp.TECH_STACK AS techStack, jp.VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount, jp.POSTS_CREATED_AT AS postsCreatedAt FROM job_posts jp JOIN company_users cu ON cu.COMPANY_IDX = jp.COMPANY_IDX ORDER BY jp.JOB_POSTS_IDX DESC

SELECT jp.JOB_POSTS_IDX AS jobPostsIdx, cu.COMPANY_NAME AS companyName, jp.VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount, jp.TITLE AS title, jp.RECRUIT_COUNT AS recruitCount, jp.EMPLOYMENT_TYPE AS employmentType, jp.SALARY AS salary, jp.WORK_TIME AS workTime, jp.CAREER AS career, jp.EDUCATION AS education, jp.TECH_STACK AS techStack, jp.APPLICATION_PERIOD AS applicationPeriod, jp.POSTS_CREATED_AT AS postsCreatedAt, jp.ATTACH_FILE AS attachFile, jp.ATTACH_FILE_ORIGIN AS attachFileOrigin, jp.COMPANY_IDX AS companyIdx FROM job_posts jp JOIN company_users cu ON cu.COMPANY_IDX = jp.COMPANY_IDX WHERE jp.JOB_POSTS_IDX = #{jobPostsIdx}
SELECT ATTACH_FILE AS attachFile, ATTACH_FILE_ORIGIN AS attachFileOrigin FROM JOB_POSTS WHERE JOB_POSTS_IDX = #{jobPostsIdx}
